title: Longest Subarray with All Distinct Elements
statement:
Given an array of integers, find the length of the longest contiguous subarray in which all elements are distinct (no repeats).

Use a sliding window with a hash map to achieve O(N) time.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the length of the longest subarray with all distinct elements.

examples.explanation: The entire array has all distinct elements.
Longest window with distinct elements is [2,1,3,4] of length 4.

arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
